name: Front Row
summary: You can easily enjoy detailed and realistic machine settings (engine, tires, body) like a real F1. Machine (team) can be selected from 8 types. Equipped with a full-scale world tour mode, aiming to become a world champion by racing on all 16 courses around the world, including Japan, England, and Australia. In addition, a single race mode where you can choose your favorite course and enjoy the race, and a time attack mode aiming for the fastest lap are also installed. Of course, the communication function allows two people to fight hotly.
